hero.description: We are determined to restore Ethiopia's agricultural capacity while promoting sustainable practices. Together, we can foster a greener, more prosperous future.

mission.subtitle: Who We Are
mission.title: Guided by Purpose
mission.description: Every action we take is rooted in our commitment to restore and sustain Ethiopia's agricultural landscape.
mission.missionText: To promote and support the sustainable management of Natural Resources, implement efficient Agricultural Technologies, and offer a range of opportunities to enhance the livelihoods of our targeted beneficiaries in partnership with States, local communities, and producers across the country.
mission.visionText: To provide economic opportunity through innovation, helping rural Ethiopia to thrive; promote agriculture production that better nourishes Ethiopians and to preserve our Nation's Natural Resources for a sustainable future.
mission.valuesText: We uphold participatory approaches, empowering communities in decision-making. We believe in integrity, sustainability, innovation, and the power of partnerships to create lasting positive change.

focusAreas.subtitle: What We Do
focusAreas.title: Our Focus Areas
focusAreas.description: We address Ethiopia's agricultural challenges through comprehensive, sustainable interventions.
focusAreas.agroforestryDesc: Establishing multistory agroforestry systems to combat deforestation, land degradation, and declining soil fertility.
focusAreas.urbanAgDesc: Promoting appropriate agricultural technologies in cities to provide alternative income for women, veterans, and unemployed youth.
focusAreas.farmImplementsDesc: Introducing efficient tillage practices and energy tools to replace the single-ox plow system and boost productivity.
focusAreas.communityDesc: Upholding participatory approaches where communities are empowered in decision-making for relevant initiatives.
focusAreas.soilDesc: Implementing sustainable land management practices including terracing, contour farming, and organic matter enrichment.
focusAreas.climateDesc: Building resilience through diversified farming systems, water harvesting, and drought-resistant crops.

impact.subtitle: Our Impact
impact.title: Making a Difference

cta.title: Help Restore Ethiopia's Agriculture and Environment
cta.description: Ethiopia's agriculture suffers from declining soil fertility, inefficient farming practices, and deforestation. Your support can transform lives.

about.pageSubtitle: Restoring Ethiopia's agricultural capacity through sustainable practices and community empowerment.
about.storyP1: ALMI Ethiopia (Agroforestry and Agricultural Land Management Initiative) was founded by a group of passionate Ethiopian professionals who have dedicated their careers to agriculture, environmental science, and community development.
about.storyP2: With decades of combined experience working with the Ethiopian Ministry of Agriculture, international development agencies, and research institutions, our team understands the unique challenges facing Ethiopian farmers.
about.storyP3: We believe that sustainable change comes from empowering communities with knowledge, tools, and resources. Our approach is rooted in participatory methodologies where local communities are active partners in every project.
about.objectiveText: To prevent or reverse the persistent deterioration of Natural Resources and the decline of soil fertility and productivity to restore and improve agricultural production, food security, and livelihoods of farming communities.
about.sustainabilityDesc: Every solution must be environmentally sound and economically viable for long-term impact.
about.participationDesc: Communities are partners, not beneficiaries. We listen, learn, and collaborate.
about.innovationDesc: We embrace new technologies and approaches while respecting traditional knowledge.
about.integrityDesc: Transparency and accountability guide every decision we make and every dollar we spend.
about.teamDesc: Dedicated professionals and volunteers working together to transform Ethiopia's agricultural landscape.
about.ceoRole: CEO and President of ALMI Ethiopia
about.accountantRole: Executive Board member and Chief Accountant

projects.pageSubtitle: Comprehensive initiatives designed to transform Ethiopia's agricultural landscape and empower communities.
projects.agroforestryDesc: A comprehensive initiative to establish multistory agroforestry systems across degraded farmlands, homesteads, and gullies.
projects.urbanDesc: Promoting appropriate agricultural technologies in urban areas to provide alternative income sources for disadvantaged groups.
projects.implementsDesc: Introducing improved farm implements and efficient energy tools to replace the outdated single-ox plow system.
projects.communityDesc: Building participatory platforms where communities actively shape project design and implementation.
projects.soilDesc: Implementing comprehensive soil conservation measures including terracing, contour farming, and organic matter enrichment.
projects.waterDesc: Developing small-scale water harvesting structures and drip irrigation systems to combat drought.
